website.data: Custom Pools You'll Love - Southlake, Fort Worth, DFW Texas Skip to content --> About Pools Freeform Swimming Pools Geometric Swimming Pools Spas & Hot Tubs Pool Remodeling Cold Tubs & Saunas Fire Features Pool School Outdoor Cabanas, Pergolas & Arbors Outdoor Lighting Custom Outdoor Kitchens & Grills Landscaping Gallery Blog Contact Areas We Serve Fort Worth DFW Dallas DFW Cities Irving Start Your Dream Pool Today 817-835-9141 Custom Designs • Serving Hurst & DFW Get a Free Quote --> Home Designing Custom Pools That Turn Backyards Into Paradise Since 1973 Award-winning craftsmanship | Locally owned & operated | 50+ years of expertise New Pool Construction Renovation Service and Maintenance Start Your Custom Backyard Project Trusted by Homeowners Since 1973 Craftsmanship That Stands the Test of Time Years of Pool Building in Hurst & Greater DFW Where Quality Meets Exceptional Service Your Dream Backyard Starts with Mid City Custom Pools Mid City Custom Pools & Outdoor Living is a family-owned and operated company established in 1973. Having grown their award-winning business primarily from referrals, owners Don & Tina Pierce and their staff, pride themselves in creating the highest quality custom pools, remodels, and outdoor living spaces with the ultimate in customer service. Pools, outdoor kitchens, fire pits, and pavilions all highlighted with special outdoor lighting are just a few of the services provided by Don and his team. Family-Owned. Expert-Led. Learn More Start the process and get in touch Contact us by calling us, emailing us or filling in our online form We’ll provide a detailed proposal Including a detailed breakdown of the final cost and estimates include the final price Review your 3D design Now’s your chance to make sure everything is looking exactly as you hoped it would! Let the build start! Our skilled crew will arrive to start turning your dreams into reality! Our Custom Pool & Outdoor Living Services in Hurst & DFW --> Geometric Swimming Pools Geometric swimming pools are a popular design choice for custom pools, in large part because they typically incorporate classic, sleek lines. Often referred to as square or rectangular pool design, geometric pools range from the simplest of designs to more intricate… Discover Timeless Pool Designs --> Freeform Swimming Pools Freeform swimming pools have become increasingly popular in recent years, and for good reason. Known for their unique, relaxed look, freeform pools are a wonderful option for homeowners looking to bring a little style to their backyard space… Create a Flowing, Freeform Pool --> Fire Place Features Fire is a source of warmth and heat that has been used since the beginning of time. While the way in which we use fire has undoubtedly changed over time, the fact still remains that there is just something comforting… Add Style + Warmth to Your Backyard --> Landscaping At Mid City Custom Pools, our landscaping services are designed to help you create a personal retreat, giving you the perfect balance of function, comfort, and beauty. We transform a basic yard into a stunning sanctuary. Choose from many customized features to create the ideal setting for you and your family, including greenery, hardscapes, lighting, and more. Design a Complete Outdoor Experience --> Spas & Hot Tubs The number one way to ensure complete bliss and satisfaction in the comfort of your home? A spa. An outdoor spa – also known as a hot tub or jacuzzi – is a must for any homeowner, especially if you are considering adding a pool or outdoor living space. reviews.text:
**Update**
New photo added, to show the carnage of our backyard demolition process. This review is not about a poorly constructed pool. It is entirely the result of MCCP not honoring their word and their warranty - ghosting us so they can avoid the problem. It only made things more disastrous for our family and is costing us tens of thousands of dollars. Hundreds if we choose to rebuild from scratch.

Original post:
Long story short, our experience with Mid City has been a nightmare. Within a year, our pool has fallen apart, cracked all throughout, won’t hold water and is leaking into our yard. There is so much water in our yard that the ground has now swelled to the point that pool is leaning. We’ve been trying to get their attention for 7 months now, and they can barely muster the energy to email back. They won’t honor a warranty, won’t call back, and when they do, they have a lot of excuses. We’ve now spent thousands trying to correct the mistake of hiring them. Mid City is extremely short handed for the amount of work they take on (their words, not mine) and can most likely build your pool quickly, but will not and cannot help you if things go wrong. Please beware.
reviews.author: Michael McFatridge

reviews.text:
Must read to the end!!

Customer service seemed fantastic at first. Follow up and follow through was stellar!!
However we needed to call them back for an issue with the pool light, to which they said it was not under warranty and would be a service call and to call the contractor they recommended. All for an item that would probably take 20 minutes and a new light ring to fix.
The pool came with a 3 year warranty and still has a little under two years left. Not sure that means anything if Mid City Pools decides they don't want to honor it.
We will just pay someone to come and repair. Wish their moral compass was a little stronger.

I am so proud to update the above review with most deserving highest marks!!
Wow Mid Cities has restored my original perception of being a top self company!

I received a call from the owner whom read my review of dissatisfaction. He very professionally explained the breakdown in communication and was expedient to take care of the issue. This is the type of customer service we all hope to give as well as receive. I highly recommend using Mid Cities Pools for any goods and services they can provide...The entire Greene family absolutely will!

Thanks Mid Cities!!

Based on the above we decided to use Mid Cities to build our next pool...and did...Evidently old behaviors DO NOT change. We built a new home and pool about 4 years ago in Colleyville. Mid Cities ability to deliver good customer service throughout the construction was not great, but we did suffer through it. However there were issues they refused to address at the end of the build and now we have an issue with the Pebble Tech Plaster we selected.

1. The issue on the build was the spa was not centered (off to the left by about 10 inches) and the spillway out of the spa is also off center about 4-5 inches. (See Picture) We felt stuck and to fix this would be to costly for us to bare on our own!

2. Recently (April of this year) we had a spot of plaster come off. In all fairness it is small (about the size of a quarter). So we looked up our plaster warranty which it clearly states it has a 15 year warranty, which is what they sold to us (see picture of warranty)  However even though we presented to Mid Cities, their own written warranty stating it is covered, they blamed the plaster manufacture and will not honor their warranty. The manufacture (Wet Edge) says it is not the product but the workmanship....which I tend to agree. Non the less Mid Cities says they are not responsible and if we want it repaired it will cost us between $500 and $1000...end of discussion.

We will fix our plaster, but it won't be thru Mid Cities. Can't afford to spend another dime with them..

In closing if you choose to build with Mid Cities, Be Cautious, they don't have a very good history in honoring their commitments!
reviews.author: Bobby Greene

reviews.text: I really thought I had dodged a bullet but it’s clear this company only cares about signing you up and getting your money. Lack of quality but even more so, zero customer service.  Only time I heard from the owner was because he wanted his last payment. A 2-week job that turned into 2 months. It’s a shame. Buyer beware for sure.
reviews.author: Syril Mathai

reviews.text: Mid City Pools just completed our pool this week. From start to finish we have been extremely pleased! Eric sold us the pool then Craig (BC) took over. BC was on the spot!  He kept us updated daily!  Each and every crew we worked with were professional and fun and got the job done in the extreme heat. We have a smaller backyard and they made our pool design work and it turned out beautiful! We broke ground on May 11th and filled the pool on July 13th. We are so happy and will recommend this company to everyone we know!!
reviews.author: Sheila Knighten

reviews.text:
Fabulous Experience!

After first contracting with another pool company who went out of business and left about 40 households with unfinished projects we went to Mid City Custom Pools to finish the remaining ~40% of the project. They were extremely understanding of our situation and gave us a good price and timeline. Final price was what they quoted and the end results are perfect!  They are a great team to work with and are extremely knowledgeable and customer-oriented.  As they have been in business since 1973 they have an excellent rapport with our city of Colleyville and quickly transferred permits. All inspections passed first time as they do quality work at each step of the way. We now have a pool, spa, arbor, and firepit that we love. When we are ready to add our outdoor kitchen they will definitely do the job. A huge thanks to MCCP which we would highly recommend to anyone.
reviews.author: Bonita Davis

reviews.text: I am a 2-time customer of Mid City Custom Pools.  Our first pool was built in 2014.  They did an amazing job giving us the pool and back patio we always wanted.  We moved in 2021 and hired them again - becoming the *extremely rare repeat customer* for a pool company.  What I love about Mid City Pools is that they use the highest quality equipment, supplies and workers.  When we built the first pool I did extensive research on pool equipment to compare the various bids we had from different companies.  Mid City pools have top-of-the-line, trusted equipment that will last.  Plus the other things you don't think as much about, like stone, decking, plaster - they only use best of the best.  Both of our yards were sloped so we needed retaining - they had all of the retaining and drainage executed perfectly.  We were amazed to discover that most of the staff and construction teams were still the same from 2014 to 2021 - some even remembered us.  That's almost unheard of and says a lot about a company.  I can't express enough about how happy we were with the entire process - from design (thanks, Sue) to construction (Derek is awesome) to finally "pool school" (Mark knows it all).  The construction lasted less than 3 months - during COVID!  The whole family is thrilled with our new pool.  Here's hoping I won't have to build a third pool - but if I do, I know I'm calling Mid City.
reviews.author: Laura Rawlings

reviews.text: Absolutely LOVE our backyard!! Working with Mid City Custom Pools in a nut shell was Fantastic! We decided we wanted to build a pool in our backyard after Covid hit. Calling around everyone was slammed and not very responsive. Even with Mid City Custom Pools being extremely busy the entire staff never made us feel like they didn’t have time for us. We did have to pick a new tile because ours was out of stock which was a little frustrating but now seeing it all together I am happy with my choice, even more than my original one! Our superintendent Derek’s communication was on point through the entire project. Sherri at the office was always there to help us with a smiling face! Must say we received high quality work with the best customer service. Overall we couldn’t have asked for a better experience! Thank you so much Mid City Pools!
reviews.author: Latasha Lee

reviews.text: My pool is currently under construction with Mid City Custom pools and the project is going better than I expected. They are fast and efficient. I worked with Eric to design my pool and he keeps me informed every step of the way. The features I got with MCP are better and more cost efficient than the other quotes I had. The pool is looking beautiful and I will be swimming before the end of the summer. Couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Heather Slayton
